 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Los Angeles Lakers will look to extend their eight-game winning streak on Tuesday night when they host the Charlotte Hornets at Crypto.com Arena in a matchup between teams heading in opposite directions.
 Jan 15, 2026; Los Angeles, California, USA; Charlotte Hornets guard Kon Knueppel (7) dribbles the ball against Los Angeles Lakers guard Luka Doncic (77) in the second half at Crypto.com Arena. Mandatory Credit: Kirby Lee-Imagn Images
 How to watch Hornets vs Lakers
 Date: Tuesday, November 17, 2026
 Time: 11:00 PM ET
 Channel: NBC
 Stream: Fubo ( try for free ) 
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Los Angeles enters the contest with an impressive 12-2 record, sitting second in the Western Conference behind the spectacular play of Luka Doncic. The superstar guard is coming off a 43-point performance in Sunday's 131-123 victory over the Phoenix Suns, continuing his dominant start to the season. The Lakers have won nine of their last 10 games and have established themselves as one of the NBA's most dangerous offensive teams. With Austin Reaves sidelined by a heel injury, Doncic will once again be counted on to lead the offense, while Walker Kessler provides a strong presence in the paint.
 Charlotte comes into the matchup at 4-9 after suffering a 113-105 defeat to the Los Angeles Clippers on Sunday. The Hornets have struggled to find consistency offensively, losing four of their last five games while shooting just 40 percent from the field this season. Naz Reid has been a bright spot, averaging 17.2 points and 8.2 rebounds per game, while Brandon Miller remains an important part of Charlotte's young core. The Hornets will need a strong defensive effort and improved shooting to have a chance at ending the Lakers' winning streak.
